Otter’s Story Treasure Hunt

Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · STORY CLUES

Otter’s Story Treasure Hunt

Look at Otter’s river story, then tap the right clue for each question.

What color is Otter’s bucket?

How many ducks are swimming?

What is floating on the river?

Treasure found!

A blue bucket, two ducks, and a boat floating by.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains story clues on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Otter’s Story Treasure Hunt worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
